parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the clock, made of durable plastic, forming the octagonal boundary of the clock.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and protection for the internal components of the clock.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hand (Minute Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum for smooth rotation.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes by rotating around the clock face once every hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously around the central axis driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Hand (Hour Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum and shorter than the minute hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hours by rotating around the clock face once every 12 hours.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates slowly around the central axis, synchronized with the minute hand.

parts.name: Surface (Clock Face)
parts.Basic_description: This is the front surface of the clock, made of transparent glass to protect the hands and display the time.
parts.Functional_description: It allows visibility of the clock hands while protecting the internal components from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part and does not move during operation.
